Anita files a missing person report for Vibhuti while Ammaji informs Angoori of her love for Billu. Later, Tiwari encourages Billu to marry Ammaji before Anita exposes Billu.

Stand-up comedians aka 'Mahabalis' deliver performances of hilarious and satirical skits with the help of their battalion of 'Yoddhas'.

An arrogant Vibhuti ignores Anita's advice about his pride. Later, he fails to credit her at his press conference, leading a concerned Manmohan to comfort her.
